from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

_SERIOUSNESS_RANK = {
    "other": 0,
    "hospitalization": 1,
    "life_threatening": 2,
    "fatal": 3,
}
_REPORTING_DAYS = {
    "fatal": 7,
    "life_threatening": 7,
    "hospitalization": 15,
    "other": 30,
}


@dataclass(frozen=True)

    event_id: str
    subject_pseudonym: str
    event_code: str
    onset: datetime
    seriousness: str
    source: str
    follow_up_of: str | None
    uncertain: bool


def _required_text(value: object, field: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"INVALID_{field.upper()}")
    return value


def _aware_utc(value: object, error_code: str) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
        raise ValueError(error_code)
    try:
        if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
            raise ValueError(error_code)
        return value.astimezone(timezone.utc)
    except (OverflowError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ValueError(error_code) from exc


def _parse_onset(value: object) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError("INVALID_ONSET")
    text = value[:-1] + "+00:00" if value.endswith("Z") else value
    try:
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ValueError("INVALID_ONSET") from exc
    return _aware_utc(parsed, "INVALID_ONSET")


def _format_utc(value: datetime) -> str:
    return value.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

import pytest

from trialops.safety import triage_events


def event(event_id, **changes):
    value = {
        "event_id": event_id,
        "subject_pseudonym": "subject-001",
        "event_code": "SYNTH-01",
        "onset": "2024-01-10T10:00:00+02:00",
        "seriousness": "other",
        "source": "site-b",
    }
    value.update(changes)
    return value


def test_chained_followups_merge_offsets_sources_and_seriousness():
    events = [
        event(
            "E2",
            follow_up_of="E1",
            onset="2024-01-09T23:30:00-05:00",
            seriousness="hospitalization",
            source="site-a",
            uncertain=True,
        ),
        event("E3", follow_up_of="E2", onset="2024-01-11T00:00:00Z", seriousness="fatal"),
        event("E1"),
    ]
    original = deepcopy(events)
    deadline = datetime(2024, 1, 17, 4, 30, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    assert triage_events(events, now=deadline) == [
        {
            "case_id": "E1",
            "subject_pseudonym": "subject-001",
            "event_code": "SYNTH-01",
            "onset": "2024-01-10T04:30:00Z",
            "seriousness": "fatal",
            "report_by": "2024-01-17T04:30:00Z",
            "sources": ["site-a", "site-b"],
            "event_ids": ["E1", "E2", "E3"],
            "uncertain": True,
            "overdue": False,
        }
    ]
    assert events == original
    assert triage_events(events, now=deadline + deadline.resolution)[0]["overdue"]


def test_cases_sort_by_onset_then_case_id():
    events = [
        event("B", onset="2024-02-01T00:00:00Z"),
        event("C", onset="2024-01-31T23:00:00Z"),
        event("A", onset="2024-02-01T00:00:00Z"),
    ]

    cases = triage_events(events, now=datetime(2024, 2, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    assert [case["case_id"] for case in cases] == ["C", "A", "B"]


def test_duplicate_ids_and_missing_roots_are_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="DUPLICATE_EVENT_ID"):
        triage_events(
            [event("E1"), event("E1")],
            now=datetime(2024, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        )
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="MISSING_ROOT"):
        triage_events(
            [event("E2", follow_up_of="absent")],
            now=datetime(2024, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc),

def test_cycles_and_mixed_case_fields_are_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="FOLLOW_UP_CYCLE"):
        triage_events(
            [event("A", follow_up_of="B"), event("B", follow_up_of="A")],

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("seriousness", "expected_report_by"),
    [
        ("fatal", "2024-01-17T00:00:00Z"),
        ("life_threatening", "2024-01-17T00:00:00Z"),
        ("hospitalization", "2024-01-25T00:00:00Z"),
        ("other", "2024-02-09T00:00:00Z"),
    ],
)
def test_offsets_use_earliest_onset_and_overdue_is_strict(
    seriousness, expected_report_by
):
    events = [
        event("root", onset="2024-01-20T00:00:00Z"),
        event(
            "follow-up",
            follow_up_of="root",
            onset="2024-01-10T00:00:00Z",
            seriousness=seriousness,
        ),
    ]
    deadline = datetime.fromisoformat(expected_report_by.replace("Z", "+00:00"))

    at_deadline = triage_events(events, now=deadline)[0]
    assert at_deadline["onset"] == "2024-01-10T00:00:00Z"
    assert at_deadline["report_by"] == expected_report_by
    assert at_deadline["overdue"] is False
    assert triage_events(events, now=deadline + deadline.resolution)[0]["overdue"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("lower", "higher"),
    [
        ("other", "hospitalization"),
        ("hospitalization", "life_threatening"),
        ("life_threatening", "fatal"),
    ],
)
def test_seriousness_precedence(lower, higher):
    events = [
        event("higher", follow_up_of="lower", seriousness=higher),
        event("lower", seriousness=lower),
    ]
    assert triage_events(
        events, now=datetime(2024, 2, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    )[0]["seriousness"] == higher


def test_all_input_orders_produce_the_same_case():
    events = [
        event("root", source="site-c"),
        event(
            "middle",
            follow_up_of="root",
            onset="2024-01-09T00:00:00Z",
            source="site-a",
            uncertain=True,
        ),
        event(
            "leaf",
            follow_up_of="middle",
            onset="2024-01-11T00:00:00Z",
            source="site-b",
            seriousness="life_threatening",
        ),
    ]
    now = datetime(2024, 2, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    expected = triage_events(events, now=now)

    assert all(triage_events(order, now=now) == expected for order in permutations(events))


def test_unknown_seriousness_and_invalid_links_have_stable_codes():
    now = datetime(2024, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="^INVALID_SERIOUSNESS$"):
        triage_events([event("A", seriousness="unknown")], now=now)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="^INVALID_FOLLOW_UP_OF$"):
        triage_events([event("A", follow_up_of="")], now=now)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="^MIXED_CASE$"):
